enrichment.headline: Amends the 1000 Broadway office lease, with monthly rent rising to $250,695.76 by 2021-22
enrichment.sourceIssueCandidate: The rent figures are printed with stray spaces ($236, 304.80 and $250, 695.76), and the item gives monthly rent but no total.
enrichment.summary: This is the fourth amendment to the lease for the district's central administrative offices at 1000 Broadway in Oakland. Monthly base rent is set for three lease years from September 1, 2019 through August 31, 2022, plus the district's share of increases in taxes and operating expenses starting January 1, 2020. The text does not give one total; the highest stated monthly rent is shown.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

notes.text: Two monthly rent amounts are printed with a stray space ($236, 304.80 and $250, 695.76), but their intended values are clear and the item states monthly rent rather than a total by design.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.text:
Approval by the Board of Education of the Fourth Amendment, Office Lease between the Oakland Unified School District (“District”), as Lessee, and Sparknight, LLC, a Florida limited liability company, as Lessor (“Lessor”), for space within the building located at 1000 Broadway, Oakland, California 94607, commonly known as the TransPacific Centre (the “Property”), for square footage described in Section 4.1 of the Fourth Amendment, for the monthly base rent, described in Section 4.2, of the Fourth Amendment, as follows:
•     $236, 304.80 (monthly) from September 1, 2019 through August 31, 2020;
•     $243,393.94 (monthly) from September 1, 2020 through August 31, 2021; and
•     $250, 695.76 (monthly) from September 1, 2021 through August 31, 2022,
plus, the pro-rata shares of increases to taxes and operating expenses beginning on January 1, 2020, as stated in Sections 4.3 (a) and 4.3(b) of the Fourth Amendment. All other terms and conditions, except those modified by this Amendment and/or prior amendments, remain in full force and effect.
items.title: Fourth Amendment, Office Lease - Sparknight, LLC - Central Administrative Offices - 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA
